projects.title: TOR Sentinel
projects.description: An investigation-focused research design for TOR traffic analysis without centralizing raw personal data.
details: Designed federated learning across ISPs without exchanging raw personally identifiable information.
Developed Adaptive Time-Window Correlation (ATWC) to address varying TOR latency.
Reported >80% probabilistic tracing confidence in simulation; proposed blockchain-backed judicial audit trails.

projects.title: Project SUTRADHAR
projects.description: A context-aware AI tutor adapting NCERT content into culturally relevant, regional-language learning experiences.
details: Led Team PARTH during the NIT Tiruchirappalli Education Track.
Built the Gurukul Context Engine around Llama-3 and Bhashini for localized explanations.
Designed regional-dialect video tutors using Stable Diffusion XL/LoRA, Wav2Lip and Tortoise TTS, with low-bandwidth messaging delivery.

projects.title: Result Analyzer
projects.description: An institutional academic analytics platform for results, grading, and student performance workflows.
details: Independently developed role-based Admin, Faculty and Student interfaces.
Created bulk Excel imports, automated SGPA/CGPA computation, and grading analytics.
Received AVIT CSE Department appreciation and won the campus Mini Product Showcase.

projects.title: AEGIS
projects.description: A dual-engine guardrail concept combining supply-chain intelligence with adaptive runtime deception.
details: Designed GhostGuard to identify package-name slopsquatting using an NPM/PyPI knowledge graph.
Architected Chimera, an adaptive digital-twin deception layer for runtime environments.
Reached semifinalist stage at the ET-AI Hackathon 2026.

projects.title: ID Masker Tool
projects.description: On-premise image and document redaction using custom object detection to locate and conceal sensitive personally identifiable information.
details: Trained a Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50) model for sensitive image and document regions.
Added black-box masking, Gaussian blur and pixelation modes for privacy-preserving redaction.
Created a desktop processing workflow using PyTorch, OpenCV, Flask and Tkinter.
Presented live at iTech Hackathon Event 2025 (Karunguzhipallam, Tamil Nadu), demonstrating real-time bounding box extraction and secure masking.

projects.title: SOVARTH / Sovereign Nexus
projects.description: Privacy-first Cardano wallet concept for verifiable identity, asset-backed lending and cross-chain finance.
details: Led Team PARTH on a wallet vision for underserved users across Asia.
Designed CIP-68 data-bound assets, identity credentials, and ZK-based credit scoring.
Placed in the Top 112 teams at Cardano Hackathon Asia 2025.

projects.title: EchoShield
projects.description: Privacy-first detection of AI-generated voices through real-time acoustic liveness signals.
details: Analyzed breathing, micro-jitters, and room-tone characteristics to detect generated speech.
Project reports 98.7% accuracy and under 1.2-second response latency.
Designed language-agnostic support across multiple Indian languages.

projects.title: Q-Shield
projects.description: Hybrid quantum-classical design to detect malicious system-call patterns before ransomware encryption.
details: Proposed C++/Rust instrumentation for system-call rhythm and graph-encoded features.
Designed a parametrized quantum circuit plus classical neural classifier.
Created an IEEE Hackathon project architecture with a Streamlit interface.

projects.title: GridWeaver
projects.description: Peer-to-peer resilient electricity network design with predictive control and secure energy exchange.
details: Designed ESP32-S3 mesh coordination and Dynamic Islanding.
Reported under 200 ms recovery in hardware-in-the-loop validation.
Integrated LSTM forecasting, ATECC608A and Proof-of-Energy-Transfer.

projects.title: SurakshaAI
projects.description: Road safety assistance combining edge vision, offline legal guidance and privacy-preserving evidence.
details: Created an accident-risk and offline legal co-pilot design.
Used LENS-Net sign detection (reported 92.56% mAP) and encrypted rolling-buffer evidence.
Explored Circom zero-knowledge proofs for privacy-preserving challan disputes.

projects.title: AgriSmart 2.0
projects.description: AI-assisted precision agriculture for crop decisions, yield optimization and farmer market access.
details: Proposed crop analysis and decision support for agricultural practices.
Connected data-driven farming assistance with direct market access.
First prize at National Science Day 2026; earlier version won third prize at SRM Hackathon.
Earlier Enhance AI Farming prototype fine-tuned VGG16 transfer learning in Jupyter and deployed a Flask-based image classification interface (reported roughly 70% prototype accuracy).

projects.title: BharatRealEstateAI
projects.description: Context-aware property discovery using multilingual intent and culturally informed recommendation logic.
details: Designed RAG-based, emotion-aware matching in 12+ Indian languages.
Included Vastu, family living and visual-similarity preferences.
Reported ~94% simulated price prediction and ~180 ms search at a simulated 2.5M+ property scale.

projects.title: NutriLens
projects.description: AI-first wellness and food coaching concept grounded in Indian regional food culture.
details: Designed cuisine-aware AI coaching and personalization.
Architected service integrations using 8+ Google Cloud services.
Shortlisted for AMD Slingshot Regional Ideathon, Bengaluru, with submission leaderboard score 95.24.

projects.title: Sanjivani
projects.description: A decentralized, offline-first health platform concept for resilient access and patient-controlled records.
details: Designed quantized Phi-3/TinyLlama multi-agent triage for on-device use.
Proposed DID/AES-256 data ownership, federated learning, and Wi-Fi Aware mesh networking.
Explored a community Health Points model.

projects.title: BioForge Dustbin
projects.description: Smart waste segregation concept pairing embedded image recognition with local biogas production.
details: Designed onboard vision classification of biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste.
Combined segregation with on-site conversion of organic waste to usable biogas.
Proposed for community and smart-city sustainability deployments.

projects.title: JobDham.in
projects.description: A deployed jobs platform with custom PHP/MySQL functionality and advertising integration.
details: Developed and hosted the web application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL.
Deployed with Hostinger and integrated Google verification and AdSense.
Described in resume as an advertising-supported, revenue-generating product.
Google Site Kit/AdSense reporting screenshot documents active advertisements and small initial revenue, not a large commercial business.

projects.title: Eduooze · School of Banking
projects.description: Banking education and candidate enrollment website developed for Eduooze Skill Institute as a web developer.
details: Developed customer-facing pages, registration pathways and event/content sections for the banking-skills organization.
Worked with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL on enrollment and product-sales workflows.
Role: Web Developer — not company founder. An earlier, separate Computer Operator offer letter is on record.

projects.title: Fashion Image Classifier
projects.description: Keras/TensorFlow clothing-image classifier trained and evaluated in Jupyter Notebook.
details: Trained on a 60,000-image fashion dataset, with a 10-class prediction task and 10 training epochs.
Implemented preprocessing, predictions, confusion-matrix analysis and classification reports.
A shared notebook screenshot displays about 0.90 overall accuracy on its 10,000-example evaluation split; results are experiment-specific.

projects.title: KAVACH TRINETRA X2
projects.description: A local-first application security workbench for authorized repository assessment, evidence-backed repair evaluation and explicit assurance decisions.
details: Built a repository intake and discovery workflow that records source identity, target hashes, finding locations, weakness classifications and supporting evidence.
Separated static discovery, candidate diffs and executable verification so a repair earns higher assurance only after supported security, regression and mission checks run.
Added optional local Ollama reasoning with a deterministic fallback, plus PRAMAAN content-addressed evidence capsules for eligible verification paths.
Received a Certificate of Appreciation for exemplary performance at the Indian Army Terrier Cyber Quest 2026.

projects.title: Q-IMMUNE CORTEX
projects.description: Post-quantum readiness and migration workflow, from cryptography inventory through canary rollout.
details: Mapped an intake → crypto discovery → CBOM → risk → PQC recommendation → quantum lab pipeline.
Explored ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, quantum simulation and a digital twin for compatibility impact.
Designed guardian controls for staged policy rollout, observability and rollback.

projects.title: DataPilot Eunoia
projects.description: Schema-aware conversational database copilot for safe SQL analytics and chart generation.
details: Developed the architecture for user intent detection, schema-grounded SQL generation and query transparency.
Designed safe query execution, multi-turn context and natural-language explanations.
Explored visualizations, ER diagrams and chart selection for relational data.

projects.title: Automated Web Security Testing
projects.description: Authorized web-app security assessment workflow integrating OWASP ZAP and a remediation-oriented dashboard.
details: Built a Flask-based front end for authorized target intake and ZAP scan orchestration.
Organized vulnerability findings by severity with evidence and suggested mitigations.
Designed SQLite-backed scan history and PDF report generation for responsible assessment.

projects.title: SAMVAAD-IQ / NETRA
projects.description: Human-in-the-loop investigation copilot concept for cited, auditable police workflows.
details: Designed a multi-language enquiry flow that connects synthetic case records, evidence checks and dossier generation.
Explored hotspot/network views, patrol planning and audit logs with source-linked explanations.
Kept analyst verification and approval at the centre of higher-impact decisions.
